north_star: Preserve a replayable record of both industrial reality and point-in-time expectations.
Standing at a historical date, future information published later must remain unavailable.
Prefer traceable and semantically comparable trajectories over a large pile of shallow snippets.
non_negotiable_invariants: Model memory is a search lead, never Evidence, Fact or Judgment.
Blind memory shards must seal before fresh web self-verification can begin.
Raw blind-recall artifacts are immutable; schema-only corrections use explicit repair overlays.
Reality, Expectation/Judgment and later Outcome remain distinguishable.
valid_time and known_time must not be collapsed.
Comparability semantics are required before corroboration or conflict decisions.
Current source material should be archived proactively and historical versions must not be overwritten.
forbidden_shortcuts: Do not start fresh web research on an unsealed blind shard.
Do not convert repeated web syndication or search rank into truth.
Do not overwrite raw model recall to make validation pass.
Do not seal a shard merely because the model says it has nothing else to recall.
Do not trust stale chat summaries or checkpoint CI status without refreshing live GitHub state.
Do not ask the user to reconstruct project context already persisted in the repository.
